main.firsname: insight:dups — first name; searchable in the explorer (lookup callout), part of the duplicate-row check; individual names are not listed on the page
main.lastname: chart-surname, insight:surname, insight:dups — most common surnames (two or more records), distinct-surname count
main.job: chart-job, chart-mix, kpi:total, kpi:roles, insight:leader, insight:ratio, insight:role_abroad — role (שוחט, בודק סכינים, בודק פנים, בודק חוץ, מנקר, ראש צוות)
main.phone: chart-loc, chart-country, chart-region, chart-mix, kpi:abroad, kpi:countries, insight:abroad, insight:region, insight:contact — private contact number, never shown; only its dialing prefix is aggregated (country code / Israeli area code)
main.cellphone: chart-loc, chart-country, chart-mix, kpi:abroad, insight:abroad, insight:contact — private contact number, never shown; only its international prefix is aggregated
